newsitem.title: USA: Nev. Reid Gardner 300 MW coal unit start delayed.
newsitem.headline: Nev. Reid Gardner 300 MW coal unit start delayed.

text.p: Restart of the 300 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the 605 MW Reid Gardner coal-fired power plant near Las Vegas has been delayed until Thursday, a spokesman for Nevada Power Co, the plant's operator, said Friday.
The unit, which has been out of service since a boiler explosion on March 2, was scheduled to restart Saturday, but additional work to overall its turbine led to the latest delay, the spokesman said.
The Reid Gardner plant is owned by a partnership of Nevada Power and the California Department of Water Resources.
